scoring_justification: Checker compares ratios to paper-reported values with tolerances and verifies monotonic trends; recompute from raw FE data not possible because only ratios are submitted.

outputs.description: File containing six rows (one per l_u/c value) with the computed axial stress ratio and discontinuity opening ratio (unbonded relative to fully bonded). The checker will compare the ratios to hidden reference values within tolerances and verify that stress_ratio strictly decreases and opening_ratio strictly increases with l_u_c.

output_contract.notes: The scoring will additionally audit the monotonic trends (stress_ratio decreasing, opening_ratio increasing) as part of verification. The agent must use a public finite element solver and all geometry/material inputs are specified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold ratios for l_u/c values from paper Figures 29/30 (linear behavior).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures 29 and 30 for linear material behavior, ΔT=27.8°C, one-sided unbonding.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate values read from figures and used as reference within tolerances.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported approximate ratios for the linear FE analysis, necessary to verify agent's reproduction against the original study.

steps.description: Check stress and opening ratios against gold values and verify monotonic trends.
